rows.whatYouDo_da: Desserter og salater står på køl i montre indtil servering.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Desserts and salads are kept chilled in a display until serving.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Montren indgår i den daglige køletemperaturkontrol.
rows.controlMeasures_en: The display is part of the daily fridge temperature check.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: Varer vurderes og kasseres ved tvivl.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Assess and discard when in doubt.

hazards.description_da: Bakterievækst i uindpakkede kølevarer i montre.
hazards.description_en: Bacterial growth in unpackaged chilled goods in the display.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Brød og focaccia serveres ved stuetemperatur samme dag.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Bread and focaccia are served at room temperature the same day.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Begrænset risiko — tørt brød uden risikoingredienser.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Limited risk — dry bread with no risk ingredients.

hazards.description_da: Fremmedlegemer i brød fra åben servering.
hazards.description_en: Foreign bodies in openly served bread.
hazards.justification_da: Lav risiko, men medtaget for fuldstændighed.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Gæster informeres om allergener mundtligt ud fra opdateret allergenoversigt.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Guests are informed about allergens verbally from an up-to-date allergen list.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Forkert eller manglende allergeninformation til gæsten.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Wrong or missing allergen information for the guest.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Allergenoversigt opdateres ved menuændringer; personale instrueres.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Allergen list updated on menu changes; staff briefed.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Inform the guest immediately; replace the dish.

hazards.description_en: Allergic reaction due to wrong information.
hazards.controlMeasure_en: A written allergen list as fixed reference.
hazards.justification_da: Mundtlig information kræver et pålideligt opslagsværk.
hazards.justification_en: Verbal information needs a reliable reference.
